teaser.en: Its swept-back petals look like flickering flames, and every part of this beautiful lily is deadly poisonous.
teaser.sw: Petali zake zilizopinda nyuma zinaonekana kama miali ya moto inayopepea, na kila sehemu ya yungiyungi huyu mrembo ni sumu kali inayoua.

summary.en: *Mpewa* is the flame lily, a climbing lily with wavy red-and-yellow flowers. It is one of the showiest wild flowers of the coast and also one of the most poisonous.
summary.sw: *Mpewa* ni *flame lily*, yungiyungi mtambaa mwenye maua mekundu na manjano yenye kingo za mawimbi. Ni mojawapo ya maua ya porini yanayopendeza zaidi pwani, na pia mojawapo ya mimea yenye sumu kali zaidi.

about.en:
*Mpewa* climbs by tendrils at the very tips of its leaves, which hook onto grass and twigs. The leaves are narrow and glossy.

The flowers are the star: six narrow, wavy-edged petals sweep backwards, yellow at the base and red towards the tips, with long stamens jutting out. As the flowers age they deepen towards crimson. The plant dies back to a fleshy underground tuber in the dry season and reappears with the rains.

All parts of *mpewa*, and especially the tuber, are very poisonous. The plant contains colchicine, and the tuber can be mistaken for an edible yam, so it is a plant worth knowing for safety.
about.sw:
*Mpewa* hupanda kwa vikonyo vya kushikilia vilivyo kwenye ncha kabisa za majani yake, vinavyonasa kwenye nyasi na vitawi. Majani ni membamba na yanang'aa.

Maua ndiyo kivutio kikuu: petali sita nyembamba zenye kingo za mawimbi hupinda kuelekea nyuma, za manjano chini na nyekundu kuelekea ncha, huku stameni ndefu zikijitokeza nje. Kadiri maua yanavyozeeka huzidi kuwa mekundu iliyokolea. Mmea hunyauka na kubaki kiazi chenye nyama chini ya ardhi wakati wa kiangazi, na huchipuka tena mvua zinaponyesha.

Sehemu zote za *mpewa*, na hasa kiazi, zina sumu kali sana. Mmea una kolkisini, na kiazi kinaweza kudhaniwa kuwa kiazi kikuu kinacholiwa, kwa hivyo ni mmea unaofaa kuujua kwa ajili ya usalama.

where.en: Look for *mpewa* in bushland and along forest edges, scrambling through grass and low shrubs. It is easiest to see after the rains, when it is in flower.
where.sw: Mtafute *mpewa* vichakani na kando ya misitu, ukitambaa katikati ya nyasi na vichaka vifupi. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona baada ya mvua, unapochanua.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.

names.en: Digo: *mpewa*. English: flame lily or glory lily. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Gloriosa superba*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mpewa*. Kwa Kiingereza: *flame lily* au *glory lily*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Gloriosa superba*.

reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine wenye sumu kali sana

reason.en: Another red-flowered climber of forest edges
reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine wenye maua mekundu wa kando ya misitu

reason.en: A yam whose tuber could be confused with a poisonous one
reason.sw: Kiazi kikuu ambacho kiazi chake kinaweza kuchanganywa na chenye sumu
